New flu vaccine expected in October
note: The new 2026–2027 Northern Hemisphere flu vaccine was expected in clinics in early to mid October, a little later than usual. If you are in a recommended group and have not had a flu jab, you can get the Southern Hemisphere vaccine now and the new one at least 8 weeks later. If you already had the Southern Hemisphere vaccine, wait for the new one.

label: Flu cases rising, no sign of more severe illness
note: Flu was spreading more in August, but illness was no more severe than usual. If you are unwell, stay home. If you must go out, wear a mask and avoid crowded places.
